  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kamailio/src/core/parser/parse_to.c","function":"parse_to","line":31,"var":"buffer/end/to_b","code":"return parse_addr_spec(buffer, end, to_b, 0);","note":"To parsing delegates to the address-spec state machine over the attacker-controlled header body."},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kamailio/src/core/parser/parse_addr_spec.c","function":"parse_addr_spec","line":786,"var":"status=URI_ENCLOSED / to_b->uri.s","code":"case ';': ... case URI_ENCLOSED: break; case URI_OR_TOKEN: ... tmp = parse_to_param(tmp, end, to_b, allow_comma_sep, &saved_status);","note":"A semicolon after an enclosed URI switches into parameter parsing and preserves the current URI start pointer."},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kamailio/src/core/parser/parse_addr_spec.c","function":"parse_to_param","line":171,"var":"status / param->value.s","code":"case 0: switch(status) { ... case S_EQUAL: case S_PARA_VALUE: saved_status = status; goto endofheader; }","note":"The input ends immediately after 'tag=' so the parameter parser exits with an unterminated value state."},
  {"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/kamailio/src/core/parser/parse_addr_spec.c","function":"parse_to_param","line":523,"var":"tmp / param->value.s","code":"case S_PARA_VALUE: ... if(status == F_CRLF) param->value.s = tmp - 2; else if(status == F_CR || status == F_LF) param->value.s = tmp - 1; else param->value.s = tmp; param->value.len = 0; add_param(param, to_b, newparam);","note":"At end-of-header, the code computes the value pointer from the current cursor even though no value bytes exist, setting up the later out-of-bounds read path in the To parameter handling."}
]
EOF
